matches.note: Harrison Butler wrestled under the name "Shade," mocking a different, previously-billed opponent who did not appear. Na Neun Park won with a three-quarters double-arm driver.
Rob Nolan and Larry Gionet won when Nolan drove Kenneth Morlock through a standing table with a spinebuster.

Originally a three-way with Sebastian Madison, who walked out before the bell. A masked Christian Madison ran in and piledrove Jaime Roberts, and Loco Fausto followed up with a tornado DDT onto a baseball bat for the pin.
Marime the Mischievous pinned Baron Adolf Blitzkrieg with a spinning back kick after a chaotic six-man brawl involving fire and a strongman's interference.
Chance Holiday won the promotion's first main event with a vertebreaker driving Caleb Foley's head into a ring bell, as Christian Copeland watched from the entrance.
